pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: ASoC: Intel: Skylake: Reconfigure HDA stream register in prepare/resume PCM prepare callbacks can be called multiple times. During S3 the stream registers will be reset when Controller is reset. When stream is resumed, these stream registers needs to reconfigured. This patch removes the check in prepare callback() if stream already prepared, which will allow reconfiguring of stream registers and also decouple stream when stream is resumed to route audio via DSP. TEST=there are no regressions observed on BSW. UPSTREAM: ASoC: Intel: Skylake: Add support for Mic Select module Mic select is a DSP module which is used to select one or many inputs to form an output. This is useful to select data selectively from PDM input and hence the name. This module is of generic module type. This patch adds support to add and configure Mic select module in firmware topology.
